module: Node "StartScreen Intro" (repeat_instant, color ui). Combined node for the start screen: intro panel, then objectives and ratings. Inputs: flow, text (string or table), includeObjectives, objectivesPage (string, optional page, main by default), includeRatings. Output: flow (chainFlow).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

work.desc: Copies flow. If text is non-empty, adds an "Intro" textPanel (main page). If requested, adds the objectives (modules.ui:addObjectives, optionally on the objectivesPage page) and the ratings (addRatings).
